summary: Odiseea Marte (Mars Odyssey) is an interactive 3D spaceflight simulator and educational game built by Team Mini Motoceii to make orbital mechanics and space mission engineering accessible to students. Instead of passively reading textbooks, players take command of an Earth–Moon–Mars mission, navigating 7 real-world engineering decision points—such as Max-Q throttle management, stage separation, solar array deployment, and atmospheric entry—where every choice balances fuel, hull integrity, and scientific return. Each decision provides immediate telemetry reports, scientific explanations, active-prediction quizzes, and a persistent Mission Logbook backed by NASA data, complemented by a 3D-printed modular rocket prototype demonstrating stage separation.
details:
How It Works & Educational Impact:

Odiseea Marte transforms complex aerospace engineering concepts into a hands-on 3D mission. Players progress through launch, Earth orbit, lunar flyby (with an optional manual Moon landing), an interactive asteroid field, Martian atmospheric entry, and a manual powered landing under Mars gravity (3.71 m/s²), plus an educational gas-giant scenario on Jupiter. Before each of the 7 critical decisions, players analyze live ship telemetry; afterward, they receive clear physics explanations, answer active-prediction check questions, and track concepts in their Mission Logbook. Between missions, players upgrade rocket subsystems (engines, tanks, heat shield, landing gear, sensors) in Hangar 7 with real-time 3D visual changes.

Tools, Hardware & Super Intelligence (SI) Acknowledgment:

- Software & Engine: Built as a standalone, offline-ready HTML5/JavaScript application powered by WebGL and Three.js (r128) with procedural planetary textures and custom orbital/landing physics.

- Physical Prototype: Designed and 3D-printed a modular physical rocket model to demonstrate multi-stage separation alongside the simulation.

- Use of Super Intelligence (AI): As 9th-grade students with no prior programming background, we used AI coding and language assistants to generate and iterate on the JavaScript/Three.js code and refine English educational texts, while our team designed the mission structure, NASA-based physics parameters, 7 decision scenarios, UI flow, and testing.
